title: Developmental programming and lineage branching of early human telencephalon.
authors: Ma, Lin; Du, Yanhua; Hui, Yi; Li, Nan; Fan, Beibei; Zhang, Xiaojie; Li, Xiaocui; Hong, Wei; Wu, Zhiping; Zhang, Shuwei; Zhou, Shanshan; Xu, Xiangjie; Zhou, Zhongshu; Jiang, Cizhong; Liu, Ling; Zhang, Xiaoqing
one_liner_zh: 该文利用scRNA-seq研究人端脑发育谱系，涉及转录因子ASCL1但无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The dorsal and ventral human telencephalons contain different neuronal subtypes, including glutamatergic, GABAergic, and cholinergic neurons, and how these neurons are generated during early development is not well understood. Using scRNA-seq and stringent validations, we reveal here a developmental roadmap for human telencephalic neurons. Both dorsal and ventral telencephalic radial glial cells (RGs) differentiate into neurons via dividing intermediate progenitor cells (IPCs_div) and early postmitotic neuroblasts (eNBs). The transcription factor ASCL1 plays a key role in promoting fate transition from RGs to IPCs_div in both regions. RGs from the regionalized neuroectoderm show heterogeneity, with restricted glutamatergic, GABAergic, and cholinergic differentiation potencies. During neurogenesis, IPCs_div gradually exit the cell cycle and branch into sister eNBs to generate distinct neuronal subtypes. Our findings highlight a general RGs-IPCs_div-eNBs developmental scheme for human telencephalic progenitors and support that the major neuronal fates of human telencephalon are predetermined during dorsoventral regionalization with neuronal diversity being further shaped during neurogenesis and neural circuit integration.
abstract_zh: 人类端脑的背侧和腹侧包含不同的神经元亚型，包括谷氨酸能、GABA能和胆碱能神经元，而这些神经元在早期发育过程中是如何产生的尚不完全清楚。通过单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）和严格验证，我们在此揭示了人类端脑神经元的发育路线图。背侧和腹侧端脑放射状胶质细胞（RGs）均通过分裂中的中间祖细胞（IPCs_div）和早期有丝分裂后神经母细胞（eNBs）分化为神经元。转录因子ASCL1在促进两个区域从RGs到IPCs_div的命运转变中发挥关键作用。来自区域化神经外胚层的RGs表现出异质性，具有受限的谷氨酸能、GABA能和胆碱能分化潜能。在神经发生过程中，IPCs_div逐渐退出细胞周期并分支为姐妹eNBs，以生成不同的神经元亚型。我们的发现突显了人类端脑祖细胞的一个通用RGs-IPCs_div-eNBs发育方案，并支持人类端脑的主要神经元命运在背腹侧区域化过程中预先决定，而神经元多样性在神经发生和神经回路整合过程中进一步塑造。
